planets.name: Kepler-41 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-41 with a 1.86-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: Kepler-41 b was found in 2011 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-41. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BONOMO_ET_AL__2015): disc_year 2011, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.85555757, pl_radj 1.29, pl_bmassj 0.56

quotes.title: Kepler-41
quotes.card: It is fairly similar to the Sun, with 115% of its mass, a radius of 129% times that of the Sun, and a surface temperature of 5,750 K. Search for stellar companions to Kepler-41 in 2013-2014 has yielded inconclusive results, compatible with Kepler-41 being the single star.

thermal.source: Esteves et al. 2015, dayside brightness temperature in the Kepler band, assuming no reflected light
thermal.chosen: the paper's value from an eclipse 44 ppm deep (+15, -16); no infrared eclipse is published
